CVE-2026-115473.description: Mongoose is an embedded web server and network library. Unauthenticated remote requests reaching mg_http_upload or mg_http_serve_dir with the affected short path shapes could therefore trigger one-byte heap out-of-bounds reads. CVE-2026-45356.title: Netatalk: Unsigned Integer Underflow in Spotlight RPC Count Decrement (sl_unpack_loop)
CVE-2026-45356.description: Netatalk is a Free and Open Source file server suite for Unix-like operating systems. Prior to 4.4.3, the afpd Spotlight RPC unmarshalling loop in etc/afpd/spotlight_marshalling.c subtracts an attacker-controlled subcount from the unsigned count variable in sl_unpack_loop without verifying that subcount is not larger. An authenticated AFP client can place an excessive element count in the sl_unpack_ints, sl_unpack_uuid, sl_unpack_floats, or sl_unpack_date handler, or in a null element, so the subtraction wraps near UINT_MAX and the loop continues reading heap memory at increasing offsets up to toc_offset, which is capped at 65000. The out-of-bounds values can be stored in dalloc structures and returned in the Spotlight RPC response, disclosing heap contents. This issue is fixed in version 4.4.3.

CVE-2026-99689.title: xfs: fix temporary cursor leak in btree shift corruption paths
CVE-2026-99689.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xfs: fix temporary cursor leak in btree shift corruption paths

In xfs_btree_lshift and xfs_btree_rshift, when XFS_IS_CORRUPT detects
an invalid firstrec/lastrec result after xfs_btree_dup_cursor has
successfully allocated a temporary cursor, the error path jumps to
error0 which returns without freeing tcur. This leaks the cursor
memory, the xfs_group reference, and the per-level buffer references
held by the duplicated cursor. Jump to error1 instead, which calls
xfs_btree_del_cursor(tcur, XFS_BTREE_ERROR) to properly release all
resources.
